property_summary: After a bonus withdrawal to any recipient, address(c).balance drops by exactly 100 wei total because rewards are zeroed after payout; the mutant fails to zero rewardsForA, so a second withdrawReward pays the same 100 wei again and the balance drops by 200.

A recipient can only ever receive the single reward amount credited to it — a re-entering call during withdrawReward must not pay out again because rewardsForA is zeroed before the external call; the mutant zeroes it after the call, letting a re-entrant attacker double-collect (200 instead of 100).

For any funding and any recipient, the total wei a recipient can ever extract (including via re-entrant withdrawReward calls triggered during the payout) never exceeds its credited reward of 100; the mutant's post-call zeroing opens a reentrancy window letting the attacker collect 200.
